Fast Casual x Francis Burger Ride

Minneapolis, MN · Road

Fast Casual x Francis Burger Ride is a road group ride in Minneapolis, MN. It rolls third Tuesday of the month at 6:30 pm from Martin Olav Sabo Bridge.

For visitors

An intermediate ride: be ready to hold 14-16 mph. Mechanical support is on hand. Free Hamm's or NA beverage for every rider. Bring helmet and lights.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14-16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @p the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Fast Casual x Francis Burger Ride group ride

Fast Casual's monthly intermediate ride runs the third Tuesday from April to October, from the Sabo Bridge to Francis Burger Joint. The pace is 14 to 16 mph over 12 to 15 miles. It is not a no-drop ride.
